script: Japan isn't just a country... it's a completely different timeline. Here are three normal things that prove they are living in the future. Number one: The underground bike vaults. Instead of bikes cluttering the streets, Japan has massive robotic shafts. You scan a card, and a machine literally swallows your bike, parking it perfectly underground. Number two: Zero-human restaurants. You don't talk to a waiter. You order on a screen, and your food shoots out on a high-speed magnetic conveyor belt directly to your table. Faster than fast food. Number three: The ultimate bathroom upgrade. Japanese toilets open automatically when you walk in, heat the seat, and even play background music to hide any... awkward noises. Could you survive in a society like this? Because...
title: The Great Emu War
hook_text: Every year, thousands of people in Japan simply evaporate into thin air.
